newsitem.title: UK: Baggeridge Brick slide on weak results.
newsitem.headline: Baggeridge Brick slide on weak results.

text.p: Shares in brick maker Baggeridge Brick Plc dropped sharply on Thursday after the firm released full-year results showing profits down 47 percent.

At 1155 GMT the stock was down 14p or 13 percent at 97-1/2p. "The year to the end of September has proved to be the worst 12 month period for brick dispatches in the United Kingdom since 1945," said chairman Peter Ward in a statement.
But he said the company had increased exports to Asia and Northern Europe and seen profits up in its land source division.
Ward said consolidation had reduced the number of brick manufacturers and would lead to a period of greater stability.
However, Baggeridge would join other brick makers in closing down for an extended period in the winter to reduce stock levels and so bring supply and demand more into balance, Ward said.
"While this will have a detrimental effect on profitability in our first half, longer-term prospects should be greatly enhanced by this action," he said.
Pre-tax profits dropped to 2.5 million stg from 4.7 million while turnover fell to 33 million stg from 36 million.
Earnings per share fell to 4.07p from 7.59p but the dividend was at 2.375p per share.
